payload.text: The next release's work builds on vc's go of 2026-11-17: cc's one ISSUE:0010 unit, with ic's text nits added to the issue as further items (ic signs every changed string before the hand-over), and ic's install-silence unit, which ic files as an issue. Each is one worktree and one Desk cargo slot; vc reads each hand-over against its issue and lands it. When the next release is cut is hv's word: one cut with everything ready, never small ones.
